verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general programmatic API for pulling cap table data: there are no API reference docs, no endpoints, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The closest feature is a read-only MCP connector that lets AI assistants answer plain-English questions about shareholders, vesting, share classes and SAFEs. That is a related but different capability (an AI-assistant connector), not a documented API for extracting the full cap table, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full capitalization table — stakeholders, share classes, securities, and vesting states — through a documented programmatic API
